characters.name: Aloy
characters.title: Savior From Another World
characters.description: Formerly an outcast, now a hunter of unparalleled skill. Ready to do the right thing at any time.

characters.name: Klee
characters.title: Fleeing Sunlight
characters.description: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius's confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

characters.name: Tartaglia
characters.title: Childe
characters.description: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.

characters.name: Varka
characters.title: Knight of Boreas
characters.description: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.

characters.name: Amber
characters.title: Gliding Champion
characters.description: Always energetic and full of life, Amber's the best — albeit only — Outrider of the Knights of Favonius.

characters.name: Barbara
characters.title: Shining Idol
characters.description: Every citizen of Mondstadt adores Barbara. She learned the word "idol" from a magazine.

characters.name: Diona
characters.title: Kätzlein Cocktail
characters.description: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.

characters.name: Sucrose
characters.title: Harmless Sweetie
characters.description: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.

characters.name: Keqing
characters.title: Driving Thunder
characters.description: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis's unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

characters.name: Qiqi
characters.title: Icy Resurrection
characters.description: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

characters.name: Shenhe
characters.title: Lonesome Transcendence
characters.description: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.

characters.name: Xiao
characters.title: Vigilant Yaksha
characters.description: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

characters.name: Yelan
characters.title: Valley Orchid
characters.description: A mysterious person who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but is a "non-entity" on the Ministry of Civil Affairs' list.

characters.name: Gaming
characters.title: Leonine Vanguard
characters.description: Guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency, and the head of the "Mighty Mythical Beasts" Wushou troupe.

characters.name: Ningguang
characters.title: Eclipsing Star
characters.description: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.

characters.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
characters.title: Pearl of Wisdom
characters.description: The Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. All of the island's affairs are at this young lady's fingertips.

characters.name: Yoimiya
characters.title: Frolicking Flames
characters.description: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as the "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.

characters.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
characters.title: Embrace of Enchanting Dreams
characters.description: A shareholder of Aisa Bathhouse, a baku, and a clinical psychologist. Dedicated to the dispersal of nightmares, and to bringing people peace of mind.

characters.name: Kirara
characters.title: Cat Upon the Eaves
characters.description: A courier for Komaniya Express, a delivery company in Inazuma. A nekomata who loves her job and human society.

characters.name: Shikanoin Heizou
characters.title: Analytical Harmony
characters.description: A young prodigy detective from the Tenryou Commission. His senses are sharp and his thoughts are clear.

characters.name: Thoma
characters.title: Protector From Afar
characters.description: The Kamisato Clan's housekeeper. A well-known "fixer" in Inazuma.

characters.name: Cyno
characters.title: Judicator of Secrets
characters.description: The General Mahamatra in charge of supervising the researchers of the Akademiya. It is said that when he gets down to work, the General Mahamatra is even more efficient than the "Great Vayuvyastra" made by the Kshahrewar.

characters.name: Tighnari
characters.title: Verdant Strider
characters.description: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart — and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.

characters.name: Candace
characters.title: Golden Vow
characters.description: A descendant of King Deshret with an amber left eye. The defender of Aaru Village.

characters.name: Faruzan
characters.title: Enigmatic Machinist
characters.description: A researcher from "one hundred years ago." She enjoys self-identifying as everyone's senior, and has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds.

characters.name: Lyney
characters.title: Spectacle of Phantasmagoria
characters.description: A famed Fontainian magician who possesses great stage presence as well as gift of the gab. Audiences are enthralled by his exquisite skills, and they hang on to his every clever word.

characters.name: Navia
characters.title: Helm of the Radiant Rose
characters.description: The current President of Spina di Rosula, who is lovely, dutiful, and a great boss.

characters.name: Neuvillette
characters.title: Ordainer of Inexorable Judgment
characters.description: The Chief Justice of Fontaine, known as the Iudex, is renowned for his unassailable impartiality.

characters.name: Sigewinne
characters.title: Wondrous Dragonheir
characters.description: A Melusine and the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. She cares equally for every convict locked in the undersea prison.

characters.name: Mavuika
characters.title: Night-Igniting Flame
characters.description: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.

characters.name: Mualani
characters.title: Splish-Splash Wavechaser
characters.description: A well-known guide in Natlan who owns a watersports shop, and expert in all forms of wave-chasing.

characters.name: Skirk
characters.title: Void Star
characters.description: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts.

characters.name: Iansan
characters.title: Tempered in Molten Stone
characters.description: Head coach of the fitness club at the Collective of Plenty, and a renowned Natlanese nutritionist.

characters.name: Diluc
characters.title: Dark Side of Dawn
characters.description: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.

characters.name: Eula
characters.title: Dance of the Shimmering Wave
characters.description: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.

characters.name: Jean
characters.title: Dandelion Knight
characters.description: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.

characters.name: Lohen
characters.title: Sharpened Arrowhead
characters.description: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.

characters.name: Mona
characters.title: Astral Reflection
characters.description: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

characters.name: Bennett
characters.title: Trial by Fire
characters.description: A good-natured adventurer from Mondstadt who's unfortunately extremely unlucky.

characters.name: Noelle
characters.title: Chivalric Blossom
characters.description: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.

characters.name: Prune
characters.title: Childlike Dreams Cherished
characters.description: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!

characters.name: Razor
characters.title: Wolf Boy
characters.description: A boy who lives among the wolves in Wolvendom of Mondstadt, away from human civilization. As agile as lightning.

characters.name: Ganyu
characters.title: Plenilune Gaze
characters.description: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.

characters.name: Hu Tao
characters.title: Fragrance in Thaw
characters.description: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

characters.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
characters.title: Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves
characters.description: A wandering samurai from Inazuma who is currently with Liyue's Crux Fleet. A gentle and carefree soul whose heart hides a great many burdens from the past.

characters.name: Chongyun
characters.title: Frozen Ardor
characters.description: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.

characters.name: Lan Yan
characters.title: Spring Woven From Jade
characters.description: A rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale. Clear-minded and well-tempered, she is as lively as a mountain spring.

characters.name: Xiangling
characters.title: Exquisite Delicacy
characters.description: A renowned chef from Liyue. She's extremely passionate about cooking and excels at making her signature hot and spicy dishes.

characters.name: Yaoyao
characters.title: Burgeoning Grace
characters.description: Streetward Rambler's youngest disciple. A gentle and caring "little adult."

characters.name: Yun Jin
characters.title: Stage Lucida
characters.description: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.

characters.name: Arataki Itto
characters.title: Hanamizaka Heroics
characters.description: The first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang, famed throughout Inazuma City's Hanamizaka... Wait, what? You've never heard of them? Are you trying to be funny here?

characters.name: Kamisato Ayaka
characters.title: Frostflake Heron
characters.description: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

characters.name: Kamisato Ayato
characters.title: Pillar of Fortitude
characters.description: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.

characters.name: Kujou Sara
characters.title: Crowfeather Kaburaya
characters.description: A general of the Tenryou Commission. Bold, decisive, and skilled in battle.

characters.name: Kuki Shinobu
characters.title: Mender of Tribulations
characters.description: The capable and reliable Arataki Gang deputy leader. Please note: capable and reliable are not appellations for the "Arataki Gang," but for their deputy leader in specific.

characters.name: Alhaitham
characters.title: Admonishing Instruction
characters.description: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.

characters.name: Nahida
characters.title: Physic of Purity
characters.description: A caged bird secluded within the confines of the Sanctuary of Surasthana who can only see the world in her dreams.

characters.name: Dori
characters.title: Treasure of Dream Garden
characters.description: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.

characters.name: Kaveh
characters.title: Empyrean Reflection
characters.description: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.

characters.name: Layla
characters.title: Fantastical Evening Star
characters.description: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.

characters.name: Clorinde
characters.title: Candlebearer, Shadowhunter
characters.description: An undefeated Champion Duelist. Sword in hand, she defends justice in the Court of Fontaine.

characters.name: Escoffier
characters.title: Tasteful Excellence
characters.description: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.

characters.name: Furina
characters.title: Endless Solo of Solitude
characters.description: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.title: Lens of Verity
characters.description: Indefatigable reporter of The Steambird, constantly on the hunt for the "truth."

characters.name: Freminet
characters.title: Yearning for Unseen Depths
characters.description: A reserved young man who is well-versed in diving. Beneath his distant, icy demeanor lies a pure heart bereft of all flaws.

characters.name: Citlali
characters.title: Obsidian Opalstar
characters.description: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.

characters.name: Kinich
characters.title: Turnfire Hunt
characters.description: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.

characters.name: Xilonen
characters.title: Ardent Flames Forge the Soul
characters.description: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.

characters.name: Ororon
characters.title: Shadow of the Night-Wind
characters.description: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind who instead lives in the wild alongside all manner of life.

characters.name: Albedo
characters.title: Kreideprinz
characters.description: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

characters.name: Durin
characters.title: "The Undying Fire"
characters.description: A dragon born from M's pen, who came to alight in the human world. His "story" continues to unfold.

characters.name: Venti
characters.title: Windborne Bard
characters.description: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.

characters.name: Dahlia
characters.title: Ode and Oblation
characters.description: Deacon of the Church of Favonius and the Anemo Archon's representative in the church.

characters.name: Fischl
characters.title: Prinzessin der Verurteilung!
characters.description: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.

characters.name: Kaeya
characters.title: Frostwind Swordsman
characters.description: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.

characters.name: Lisa
characters.title: Witch of Purple Rose
characters.description: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

characters.name: Mika
characters.title: Coordinates of Clear Frost
characters.description: A young knight born to an ordinary family. He serves as a Front-Line Surveyor in his Company. He is a low-key and cautious character.

characters.name: Rosaria
characters.title: Thorny Benevolence
characters.description: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.

characters.name: Baizhu
characters.title: Beyond Mortality
characters.description: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.

characters.name: Xianyun
characters.title: Passerine Herald
characters.description: One of the Mighty and Illuminated Adepti of Jueyun, known as "Cloud Retainer." Expert in all kinds of mechanical contraptions, her heart now turns towards the affairs of the mortal world, through which she walks under the name "Xianyun."

characters.name: Zhongli
characters.title: Vago Mundo
characters.description: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.

characters.name: Zibai
characters.title: White Horse's Fleeting Spring
characters.description: The White Horse Adeptus from Liyue's legends, known as Zibai. The most mysterious figure in Liyue's myths.

characters.name: Beidou
characters.title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
characters.description: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

characters.name: Xingqiu
characters.title: Juvenile Galant
characters.description: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

characters.name: Xinyan
characters.title: Blazing Riff
characters.description: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.

characters.name: Yanfei
characters.title: Wise Innocence
characters.description: A well-known legal adviser active in Liyue Harbor. A brilliant young lady in whose veins runs the blood of an illuminated beast.

characters.name: Chiori
characters.title: The Thundering Seamstress
characters.description: The owner of Chioriya Boutique. A tailor renowned throughout Fontaine.

characters.name: Raiden Shogun
characters.title: Plane of Euthymia
characters.description: Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, who promised the people of Inazuma an unchanging Eternity.

characters.name: Yae Miko
characters.title: Astute Amusement
characters.description: Lady Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Also serves as the editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Unimaginable intelligence and cunning are hidden under her beautiful appearance.

characters.name: Gorou
characters.title: Canine Warrior
characters.description: The great general of Watatsumi Island's forces. He is deeply trusted by his subordinates.

characters.name: Sayu
characters.title: Mujina Ninja
characters.description: A pint-sized ninja attached to the Shuumatsuban, who always seems sleep-deprived.

characters.name: Dehya
characters.title: Flame-Mane
characters.description: A member of the Eremites, a mercenary organization that roams the sands of Sumeru. Valiant and powerful, she enjoys great fame amongst her fellow Eremites.

characters.name: Nilou
characters.title: Dance of Lotuslight
characters.description: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.

characters.name: Wanderer
characters.title: Eons Adrift
characters.description: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.

characters.name: Collei
characters.title: Sprout of Rebirth
characters.description: A trainee ranger active in Avidya Forest. Behind her enthusiastic words and actions hides a slightly introverted personality.

characters.name: Sethos
characters.title: Wisdom's Measure
characters.description: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.

characters.name: Arlecchino
characters.title: Dire Balemoon
characters.description: "The Knave," Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A poised, ruthless diplomat. To the children in the House of the Hearth, she is their feared yet dependable "Father."

characters.name: Emilie
characters.title: A Thousand Scents Traced
characters.description: A Fontainian perfumer, one who bottles secrets.

characters.name: Wriothesley
characters.title: Emissary of Solitary Iniquity
characters.description: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide, Lord Incognito of the murky depths.

characters.name: Chevreuse
characters.title: Executor of Justice
characters.description: The captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, who wears justice as an ever-present seal upon her heart. Her musket shall only ever point at the guilty.

characters.name: Lynette
characters.title: Elegance in the Shadows
characters.description: A magic assistant of few words, her emotions are as inscrutable as any cat's.

characters.name: Chasca
characters.title: Skyborne Arbiter
characters.description: The Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, the ender of all disputes.

characters.name: Ineffa
characters.title: Boom Boom Thunderwave
characters.description: A multifunctional robot containing integrated mechanical components from various nations. The Source Core in her chest has endured the passage of countless years.

characters.name: Varesa
characters.title: Strength in Serenity
characters.description: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!

characters.name: Ifa
characters.title: In the Wake of Wandering Winds
characters.description: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.

characters.name: Kachina
characters.title: Mottled Gold Yet Unsmelted
characters.description: A young warrior of the Nanatzcayan, given the Ancient Name of "Uthabiti." Kind-hearted and insatiably persistent, she grows stronger and more capable with each setback she faces.

characters.title: Savior From Another World
characters.description: Formerly an outcast, now a hunter of unparalleled skill. Ready to do the right thing at any time.

characters.description: Head coach of the fitness club at the Collective of Plenty, and a renowned Natlanese nutritionist.

characters.name: Diluc
characters.title: Dark Side of Dawn
characters.description: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.

characters.name: Eula
characters.title: Dance of the Shimmering Wave
characters.description: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.

characters.name: Jean
characters.title: Dandelion Knight
characters.description: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.

characters.name: Lohen
characters.title: Sharpened Arrowhead
characters.description: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.

characters.name: Mona
characters.title: Astral Reflection
characters.description: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

characters.name: Bennett
characters.title: Trial by Fire
characters.description: A good-natured adventurer from Mondstadt who's unfortunately extremely unlucky.

characters.name: Noelle
characters.title: Chivalric Blossom
characters.description: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.

characters.name: Prune
characters.title: Childlike Dreams Cherished
characters.description: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!

characters.name: Razor
characters.title: Wolf Boy
characters.description: A boy who lives among the wolves in Wolvendom of Mondstadt, away from human civilization. As agile as lightning.

characters.name: Ganyu
characters.title: Plenilune Gaze
characters.description: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.

characters.name: Hu Tao
characters.title: Fragrance in Thaw
characters.description: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

characters.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
characters.title: Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves
characters.description: A wandering samurai from Inazuma who is currently with Liyue's Crux Fleet. A gentle and carefree soul whose heart hides a great many burdens from the past.

characters.name: Chongyun
characters.title: Frozen Ardor
characters.description: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.

characters.name: Lan Yan
characters.title: Spring Woven From Jade
characters.description: A rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale. Clear-minded and well-tempered, she is as lively as a mountain spring.

characters.name: Xiangling
characters.title: Exquisite Delicacy
characters.description: A renowned chef from Liyue. She's extremely passionate about cooking and excels at making her signature hot and spicy dishes.

characters.name: Yaoyao
characters.title: Burgeoning Grace
characters.description: Streetward Rambler's youngest disciple. A gentle and caring "little adult."

characters.name: Yun Jin
characters.title: Stage Lucida
characters.description: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.

characters.name: Arataki Itto
characters.title: Hanamizaka Heroics
characters.description: The first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang, famed throughout Inazuma City's Hanamizaka... Wait, what? You've never heard of them? Are you trying to be funny here?

characters.name: Kamisato Ayaka
characters.title: Frostflake Heron
characters.description: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

characters.name: Kamisato Ayato
characters.title: Pillar of Fortitude
characters.description: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.

characters.name: Kujou Sara
characters.title: Crowfeather Kaburaya
characters.description: A general of the Tenryou Commission. Bold, decisive, and skilled in battle.

characters.name: Kuki Shinobu
characters.title: Mender of Tribulations
characters.description: The capable and reliable Arataki Gang deputy leader. Please note: capable and reliable are not appellations for the "Arataki Gang," but for their deputy leader in specific.

characters.name: Alhaitham
characters.title: Admonishing Instruction
characters.description: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.

characters.name: Nahida
characters.title: Physic of Purity
characters.description: A caged bird secluded within the confines of the Sanctuary of Surasthana who can only see the world in her dreams.

characters.name: Dori
characters.title: Treasure of Dream Garden
characters.description: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.

characters.name: Kaveh
characters.title: Empyrean Reflection
characters.description: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.

characters.name: Layla
characters.title: Fantastical Evening Star
characters.description: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.

characters.name: Clorinde
characters.title: Candlebearer, Shadowhunter
characters.description: An undefeated Champion Duelist. Sword in hand, she defends justice in the Court of Fontaine.

characters.name: Escoffier
characters.title: Tasteful Excellence
characters.description: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.

characters.name: Furina
characters.title: Endless Solo of Solitude
characters.description: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.title: Lens of Verity
characters.description: Indefatigable reporter of The Steambird, constantly on the hunt for the "truth."

characters.name: Freminet
characters.title: Yearning for Unseen Depths
characters.description: A reserved young man who is well-versed in diving. Beneath his distant, icy demeanor lies a pure heart bereft of all flaws.

characters.name: Citlali
characters.title: Obsidian Opalstar
characters.description: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.

characters.name: Kinich
characters.title: Turnfire Hunt
characters.description: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.

characters.name: Xilonen
characters.title: Ardent Flames Forge the Soul
characters.description: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.

characters.name: Ororon
characters.title: Shadow of the Night-Wind
characters.description: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind who instead lives in the wild alongside all manner of life.

characters.name: Albedo
characters.title: Kreideprinz
characters.description: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

characters.name: Durin
characters.title: "The Undying Fire"
characters.description: A dragon born from M's pen, who came to alight in the human world. His "story" continues to unfold.

characters.name: Venti
characters.title: Windborne Bard
characters.description: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.

characters.name: Dahlia
characters.title: Ode and Oblation
characters.description: Deacon of the Church of Favonius and the Anemo Archon's representative in the church.

characters.name: Fischl
characters.title: Prinzessin der Verurteilung!
characters.description: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.

characters.name: Kaeya
characters.title: Frostwind Swordsman
characters.description: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.

characters.name: Lisa
characters.title: Witch of Purple Rose
characters.description: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

characters.name: Mika
characters.title: Coordinates of Clear Frost
characters.description: A young knight born to an ordinary family. He serves as a Front-Line Surveyor in his Company. He is a low-key and cautious character.

characters.name: Rosaria
characters.title: Thorny Benevolence
characters.description: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.

characters.name: Baizhu
characters.title: Beyond Mortality
characters.description: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.

characters.name: Xianyun
characters.title: Passerine Herald
characters.description: One of the Mighty and Illuminated Adepti of Jueyun, known as "Cloud Retainer." Expert in all kinds of mechanical contraptions, her heart now turns towards the affairs of the mortal world, through which she walks under the name "Xianyun."

characters.name: Zhongli
characters.title: Vago Mundo
characters.description: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.

characters.name: Zibai
characters.title: White Horse's Fleeting Spring
characters.description: The White Horse Adeptus from Liyue's legends, known as Zibai. The most mysterious figure in Liyue's myths.

characters.name: Beidou
characters.title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
characters.description: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

characters.name: Xingqiu
characters.title: Juvenile Galant
characters.description: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

characters.name: Xinyan
characters.title: Blazing Riff
characters.description: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.

characters.name: Yanfei
characters.title: Wise Innocence
characters.description: A well-known legal adviser active in Liyue Harbor. A brilliant young lady in whose veins runs the blood of an illuminated beast.

characters.name: Chiori
characters.title: The Thundering Seamstress
characters.description: The owner of Chioriya Boutique. A tailor renowned throughout Fontaine.

characters.name: Raiden Shogun
characters.title: Plane of Euthymia
characters.description: Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, who promised the people of Inazuma an unchanging Eternity.

characters.name: Yae Miko
characters.title: Astute Amusement
characters.description: Lady Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Also serves as the editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Unimaginable intelligence and cunning are hidden under her beautiful appearance.

characters.name: Gorou
characters.title: Canine Warrior
characters.description: The great general of Watatsumi Island's forces. He is deeply trusted by his subordinates.

characters.name: Sayu
characters.title: Mujina Ninja
characters.description: A pint-sized ninja attached to the Shuumatsuban, who always seems sleep-deprived.

characters.name: Dehya
characters.title: Flame-Mane
characters.description: A member of the Eremites, a mercenary organization that roams the sands of Sumeru. Valiant and powerful, she enjoys great fame amongst her fellow Eremites.

characters.name: Nilou
characters.title: Dance of Lotuslight
characters.description: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.

characters.name: Wanderer
characters.title: Eons Adrift
characters.description: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.

characters.name: Collei
characters.title: Sprout of Rebirth
characters.description: A trainee ranger active in Avidya Forest. Behind her enthusiastic words and actions hides a slightly introverted personality.

characters.name: Sethos
characters.title: Wisdom's Measure
characters.description: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.

characters.name: Arlecchino
characters.title: Dire Balemoon
characters.description: "The Knave," Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A poised, ruthless diplomat. To the children in the House of the Hearth, she is their feared yet dependable "Father."

characters.name: Emilie
characters.title: A Thousand Scents Traced
characters.description: A Fontainian perfumer, one who bottles secrets.

characters.name: Wriothesley
characters.title: Emissary of Solitary Iniquity
characters.description: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide, Lord Incognito of the murky depths.

characters.name: Chevreuse
characters.title: Executor of Justice
characters.description: The captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, who wears justice as an ever-present seal upon her heart. Her musket shall only ever point at the guilty.

characters.name: Lynette
characters.title: Elegance in the Shadows
characters.description: A magic assistant of few words, her emotions are as inscrutable as any cat's.

characters.name: Chasca
characters.title: Skyborne Arbiter
characters.description: The Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, the ender of all disputes.

characters.name: Ineffa
characters.title: Boom Boom Thunderwave
characters.description: A multifunctional robot containing integrated mechanical components from various nations. The Source Core in her chest has endured the passage of countless years.

characters.name: Varesa
characters.title: Strength in Serenity
characters.description: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!

characters.name: Ifa
characters.title: In the Wake of Wandering Winds
characters.description: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.

characters.name: Kachina
characters.title: Mottled Gold Yet Unsmelted
characters.description: A young warrior of the Nanatzcayan, given the Ancient Name of "Uthabiti." Kind-hearted and insatiably persistent, she grows stronger and more capable with each setback she faces.

characters.name: Aloy
characters.title: Savior From Another World
characters.description: Formerly an outcast, now a hunter of unparalleled skill. Ready to do the right thing at any time.

characters.name: Klee
characters.title: Fleeing Sunlight
characters.description: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius's confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

characters.name: Tartaglia
characters.title: Childe
characters.description: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.

characters.name: Varka
characters.title: Knight of Boreas
characters.description: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.

characters.name: Amber
characters.title: Gliding Champion
characters.description: Always energetic and full of life, Amber's the best — albeit only — Outrider of the Knights of Favonius.

characters.name: Barbara
characters.title: Shining Idol
characters.description: Every citizen of Mondstadt adores Barbara. She learned the word "idol" from a magazine.

characters.name: Diona
characters.title: Kätzlein Cocktail
characters.description: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.

characters.name: Sucrose
characters.title: Harmless Sweetie
characters.description: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.

characters.title: Driving Thunder
characters.description: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis's unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

characters.name: Qiqi
characters.title: Icy Resurrection
characters.description: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

characters.name: Shenhe
characters.title: Lonesome Transcendence
characters.description: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.

characters.name: Xiao
characters.title: Vigilant Yaksha
characters.description: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

characters.name: Yelan
characters.title: Valley Orchid
characters.description: A mysterious person who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but is a "non-entity" on the Ministry of Civil Affairs' list.

characters.name: Gaming
characters.title: Leonine Vanguard
characters.description: Guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency, and the head of the "Mighty Mythical Beasts" Wushou troupe.

characters.title: Eclipsing Star
characters.description: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.

characters.title: Frolicking Flames
characters.description: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as the "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.

characters.title: Embrace of Enchanting Dreams
characters.description: A shareholder of Aisa Bathhouse, a baku, and a clinical psychologist. Dedicated to the dispersal of nightmares, and to bringing people peace of mind.

characters.name: Kirara
characters.title: Cat Upon the Eaves
characters.description: A courier for Komaniya Express, a delivery company in Inazuma. A nekomata who loves her job and human society.

characters.title: Analytical Harmony
characters.description: A young prodigy detective from the Tenryou Commission. His senses are sharp and his thoughts are clear.

characters.name: Nilou
characters.title: Dance of Lotuslight
characters.description: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.

characters.name: Wanderer
characters.title: Eons Adrift
characters.description: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.

characters.name: Collei
characters.title: Sprout of Rebirth
characters.description: A trainee ranger active in Avidya Forest. Behind her enthusiastic words and actions hides a slightly introverted personality.

characters.name: Sethos
characters.title: Wisdom's Measure
characters.description: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.

characters.name: Cyno
characters.title: Judicator of Secrets
characters.description: The General Mahamatra in charge of supervising the researchers of the Akademiya. It is said that when he gets down to work, the General Mahamatra is even more efficient than the "Great Vayuvyastra" made by the Kshahrewar.

characters.name: Tighnari
characters.title: Verdant Strider
characters.description: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart — and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.

characters.name: Candace
characters.title: Golden Vow
characters.description: A descendant of King Deshret with an amber left eye. The defender of Aaru Village.

characters.name: Faruzan
characters.title: Enigmatic Machinist
characters.description: A researcher from "one hundred years ago." She enjoys self-identifying as everyone's senior, and has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds.

characters.name: Alhaitham
characters.title: Admonishing Instruction
characters.description: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.

characters.name: Nahida
characters.title: Physic of Purity
characters.description: A caged bird secluded within the confines of the Sanctuary of Surasthana who can only see the world in her dreams.

characters.name: Dori
characters.title: Treasure of Dream Garden
characters.description: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.

characters.name: Kaveh
characters.title: Empyrean Reflection
characters.description: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.

characters.name: Layla
characters.title: Fantastical Evening Star
characters.description: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.

characters.name: Clorinde
characters.title: Candlebearer, Shadowhunter
characters.description: An undefeated Champion Duelist. Sword in hand, she defends justice in the Court of Fontaine.

characters.name: Escoffier
characters.title: Tasteful Excellence
characters.description: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.

characters.name: Furina
characters.title: Endless Solo of Solitude
characters.description: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.

characters.name: Charlotte
characters.title: Lens of Verity
characters.description: Indefatigable reporter of The Steambird, constantly on the hunt for the "truth."

characters.name: Freminet
characters.title: Yearning for Unseen Depths
characters.description: A reserved young man who is well-versed in diving. Beneath his distant, icy demeanor lies a pure heart bereft of all flaws.

characters.name: Arlecchino
characters.title: Dire Balemoon
characters.description: "The Knave," Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A poised, ruthless diplomat. To the children in the House of the Hearth, she is their feared yet dependable "Father."

characters.name: Emilie
characters.title: A Thousand Scents Traced
characters.description: A Fontainian perfumer, one who bottles secrets.

characters.name: Wriothesley
characters.title: Emissary of Solitary Iniquity
characters.description: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide, Lord Incognito of the murky depths.

characters.name: Chevreuse
characters.title: Executor of Justice
characters.description: The captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, who wears justice as an ever-present seal upon her heart. Her musket shall only ever point at the guilty.

characters.name: Lynette
characters.title: Elegance in the Shadows
characters.description: A magic assistant of few words, her emotions are as inscrutable as any cat's.

characters.name: Lyney
characters.title: Spectacle of Phantasmagoria
characters.description: A famed Fontainian magician who possesses great stage presence as well as gift of the gab. Audiences are enthralled by his exquisite skills, and they hang on to his every clever word.

characters.name: Navia
characters.title: Helm of the Radiant Rose
characters.description: The current President of Spina di Rosula, who is lovely, dutiful, and a great boss.

characters.name: Neuvillette
characters.title: Ordainer of Inexorable Judgment
characters.description: The Chief Justice of Fontaine, known as the Iudex, is renowned for his unassailable impartiality.

characters.name: Sigewinne
characters.title: Wondrous Dragonheir
characters.description: A Melusine and the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. She cares equally for every convict locked in the undersea prison.

characters.name: Citlali
characters.title: Obsidian Opalstar
characters.description: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.

characters.name: Kinich
characters.title: Turnfire Hunt
characters.description: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.

characters.name: Xilonen
characters.title: Ardent Flames Forge the Soul
characters.description: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.

characters.name: Ororon
characters.title: Shadow of the Night-Wind
characters.description: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind who instead lives in the wild alongside all manner of life.

characters.name: Chasca
characters.title: Skyborne Arbiter
characters.description: The Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, the ender of all disputes.

characters.name: Ineffa
characters.title: Boom Boom Thunderwave
characters.description: A multifunctional robot containing integrated mechanical components from various nations. The Source Core in her chest has endured the passage of countless years.

characters.name: Varesa
characters.title: Strength in Serenity
characters.description: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!

characters.name: Ifa
characters.title: In the Wake of Wandering Winds
characters.description: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.

characters.name: Kachina
characters.title: Mottled Gold Yet Unsmelted
characters.description: A young warrior of the Nanatzcayan, given the Ancient Name of "Uthabiti." Kind-hearted and insatiably persistent, she grows stronger and more capable with each setback she faces.

characters.name: Mavuika
characters.title: Night-Igniting Flame
characters.description: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.

characters.name: Mualani
characters.title: Splish-Splash Wavechaser
characters.description: A well-known guide in Natlan who owns a watersports shop, and expert in all forms of wave-chasing.

characters.name: Skirk
characters.title: Void Star
characters.description: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts.

characters.name: Iansan
characters.title: Tempered in Molten Stone
characters.description: Head coach of the fitness club at the Collective of Plenty, and a renowned Natlanese nutritionist.

1.name: Jahoda
1.title: Windthreading Shadow
1.description: The Curatorium of Secrets' extremely reliable, do-it-all super employee (or so she claims).

1.name: Lan Yan
1.title: Spring Woven From Jade
1.description: A rattan weaver from Chenyu Vale. Clear-minded and well-tempered, she is as lively as a mountain spring.

1.name: Thoma
1.title: Protector From Afar
1.description: The Kamisato Clan's housekeeper. A well-known "fixer" in Inazuma.

1.name: Chevreuse
1.title: Executor of Justice
1.description: The captain of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol, who wears justice as an ever-present seal upon her heart. Her musket shall only ever point at the guilty.

1.name: Sandrone
1.title: Mirrored Analysis
1.description: The Seventh of the Fatui Harbingers, "Marionette." Interprets all phenomena through the prism of mathematics, and is an elegant lady who is never absent from a tea party.

1.name: Columbina
1.title: Welkin Moon's Homecoming
1.description: The Moon Maiden born in Nod-Krai, and also the welkin moon returning home.

1.name: Diona
1.title: Kätzlein Cocktail
1.description: A young lady who has inherited trace amounts of non-human blood. She is the incredibly popular bartender of the Cat's Tail tavern.

1.name: Citlali
1.title: Obsidian Opalstar
1.description: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.

1.name: Kirara
1.title: Cat Upon the Eaves
1.description: A courier for Komaniya Express, a delivery company in Inazuma. A nekomata who loves her job and human society.

1.name: Rosaria
1.title: Thorny Benevolence
1.description: A sister of the church, though you wouldn't know it if it weren't for her attire. Known for her sharp, cold words and manner, she often works alone.

2.name: Lynette
2.title: Elegance in the Shadows
2.description: A magic assistant of few words, her emotions are as inscrutable as any cat's.

2.name: Lyney
2.title: Spectacle of Phantasmagoria
2.description: A famed Fontainian magician who possesses great stage presence as well as gift of the gab. Audiences are enthralled by his exquisite skills, and they hang on to his every clever word.

2.name: Vesna
2.title: Snowy Banquet's Sharp Blade
2.description: Commander of the Druzhna and the Tsaritsa's keen blade.

2.name: Alyosha
2.title: Swift-Striding Hound
2.description: A "professional hunter" and master of the Snezhnayan snowfields. A fierce, distinct "idealism" burns beneath his calm demeanor.

2.name: Alhaitham
2.title: Admonishing Instruction
2.description: The current scribe of the Sumeru Akademiya, a man endowed with extraordinary intelligence and talent. He lives free — free from the searching eyes of ordinary people, anyway.

2.name: Beidou
2.title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
2.description: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

2.name: Varka
2.title: Knight of Boreas
2.description: Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Knight of Boreas, protector of Mondstadt.

2.name: Odette
2.title: Swirling Snow
2.description: A famed Snezhnayan ballerina who blossoms against the frozen landscape with a beauty as sharp as frost.

2.name: Sangonomiya Kokomi
2.title: Pearl of Wisdom
2.description: The Divine Priestess of Watatsumi Island. All of the island's affairs are at this young lady's fingertips.

2.name: Bennett
2.title: Trial by Fire
2.description: A good-natured adventurer from Mondstadt who's unfortunately extremely unlucky.

3.name: Lauma
3.title: Evermoon's Sacrament Song
3.description: A Maiden blessed by moonlight and the grove alike, hope born to the Frostmoon Scions.

3.name: Qiqi
3.title: Icy Resurrection
3.description: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

3.name: Yaoyao
3.title: Burgeoning Grace
3.description: Streetward Rambler's youngest disciple. A gentle and caring "little adult."

3.name: Shenhe
3.title: Lonesome Transcendence
3.description: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.

3.name: Xilonen
3.title: Ardent Flames Forge the Soul
3.description: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.

3.name: Durin
3.title: "The Undying Fire"
3.description: A dragon born from M's pen, who came to alight in the human world. His "story" continues to unfold.

3.name: Jean
3.title: Dandelion Knight
3.description: The righteous and rigorous Dandelion Knight, and Acting Grand Master of Mondstadt's Knights of Favonius.

3.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
3.title: Embrace of Enchanting Dreams
3.description: A shareholder of Aisa Bathhouse, a baku, and a clinical psychologist. Dedicated to the dispersal of nightmares, and to bringing people peace of mind.

3.name: Noelle
3.title: Chivalric Blossom
3.description: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.

3.name: Ifa
3.title: In the Wake of Wandering Winds
3.description: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.

3.name: Kamisato Ayato
3.title: Pillar of Fortitude
3.description: The young but highly accomplished head of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Cultured and polite, he is a man of many ways and means.

3.name: Vodyanitsa
3.title: Lingering Siren-Song
3.description: Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe and a Water Imp who has parted from her kin.

3.name: Sigewinne
3.title: Wondrous Dragonheir
3.description: A Melusine and the Fortress of Meropide's head nurse. She cares equally for every convict locked in the undersea prison.

4.name: Ineffa
4.title: Boom Boom Thunderwave
4.description: A multifunctional robot containing integrated mechanical components from various nations. The Source Core in her chest has endured the passage of countless years.

4.name: Lohen
4.title: Sharpened Arrowhead
4.description: Vice Captain of the Knights of Favonius Ranged Company, a knight known for his unorthodox approach and fondness for unconventional tactics.

4.name: Aloy
4.title: Savior From Another World
4.description: Formerly an outcast, now a hunter of unparalleled skill. Ready to do the right thing at any time.

4.name: Dehya
4.title: Flame-Mane
4.description: A member of the Eremites, a mercenary organization that roams the sands of Sumeru. Valiant and powerful, she enjoys great fame amongst her fellow Eremites.

4.name: Charlotte
4.title: Lens of Verity
4.description: Indefatigable reporter of The Steambird, constantly on the hunt for the "truth."

4.name: Xianyun
4.title: Passerine Herald
4.description: One of the Mighty and Illuminated Adepti of Jueyun, known as "Cloud Retainer." Expert in all kinds of mechanical contraptions, her heart now turns towards the affairs of the mortal world, through which she walks under the name "Xianyun."

4.name: Xiao
4.title: Vigilant Yaksha
4.description: A yaksha adeptus who defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

4.name: Yelan
4.title: Valley Orchid
4.description: A mysterious person who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but is a "non-entity" on the Ministry of Civil Affairs' list.

4.name: Kachina
4.title: Mottled Gold Yet Unsmelted
4.description: A young warrior of the Nanatzcayan, given the Ancient Name of "Uthabiti." Kind-hearted and insatiably persistent, she grows stronger and more capable with each setback she faces.

4.name: Baizhu
4.title: Beyond Mortality
4.description: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.

4.name: Diluc
4.title: Dark Side of Dawn
4.description: The tycoon of a winery empire in Mondstadt, unmatched in every possible way.

5.name: Candace
5.title: Golden Vow
5.description: A descendant of King Deshret with an amber left eye. The defender of Aaru Village.

5.name: Collei
5.title: Sprout of Rebirth
5.description: A trainee ranger active in Avidya Forest. Behind her enthusiastic words and actions hides a slightly introverted personality.

5.name: Nefer
5.title: Secret Beneath the Sands
5.description: The remarkably resourceful owner of the Curatorium of Secrets.

5.name: Zibai
5.title: White Horse's Fleeting Spring
5.description: The White Horse Adeptus from Liyue's legends, known as Zibai. The most mysterious figure in Liyue's myths.

5.name: Gorou
5.title: Canine Warrior
5.description: The great general of Watatsumi Island's forces. He is deeply trusted by his subordinates.

5.name: Yun Jin
5.title: Stage Lucida
5.description: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.

5.name: Linnea
5.title: Augur of Wonders
5.description: Naturalist and Advisor to the Nod-Krai Branch of the Adventurers' Guild.

5.name: Dahlia
5.title: Ode and Oblation
5.description: Deacon of the Church of Favonius and the Anemo Archon's representative in the church.

5.name: Fischl
5.title: Prinzessin der Verurteilung!
5.description: A mysterious girl who calls herself "Prinzessin der Verurteilung" and travels with a night raven named Oz.

5.name: Sethos
5.title: Wisdom's Measure
5.description: The Temple of Silence's heir. Burdened with secrets, he comes from the sands.

6.name: Arataki Itto
6.title: Hanamizaka Heroics
6.description: The first and greatest head of the Arataki Gang, famed throughout Inazuma City's Hanamizaka... Wait, what? You've never heard of them? Are you trying to be funny here?

6.name: Escoffier
6.title: Tasteful Excellence
6.description: The ex-head chef of Hotel Debord, renowned throughout Fontaine as the Patissiere Supreme and vanguard of precision gastronomy. Has incomparably strict standards when it comes to cooking.

6.name: Lisa
6.title: Witch of Purple Rose
6.description: The languid but knowledgeable Librarian of the Knights of Favonius, deemed by Sumeru Akademiya to be their most distinguished graduate in the past two centuries.

6.name: Venti
6.title: Windborne Bard
6.description: One of the many bards of Mondstadt, who freely wanders the city's streets and alleys.

6.name: Yoimiya
6.title: Frolicking Flames
6.description: Owner of Naganohara Fireworks. Known as the "Queen of the Summer Festival," she excels in her craft of creating fireworks that symbolize people's hopes and dreams.

6.name: Cyno
6.title: Judicator of Secrets
6.description: The General Mahamatra in charge of supervising the researchers of the Akademiya. It is said that when he gets down to work, the General Mahamatra is even more efficient than the "Great Vayuvyastra" made by the Kshahrewar.

6.name: Raiden Shogun
6.title: Plane of Euthymia
6.description: Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho, who promised the people of Inazuma an unchanging Eternity.

6.name: Yae Miko
6.title: Astute Amusement
6.description: Lady Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Also serves as the editor-in-chief of Yae Publishing House. Unimaginable intelligence and cunning are hidden under her beautiful appearance.

7.name: Barbara
7.title: Shining Idol
7.description: Every citizen of Mondstadt adores Barbara. She learned the word "idol" from a magazine.

7.name: Kaveh
7.title: Empyrean Reflection
7.description: A renowned architect from Sumeru who perhaps cares a bit too much about too many things. He is an aesthete troubled by reality.

7.name: Kujou Sara
7.title: Crowfeather Kaburaya
7.description: A general of the Tenryou Commission. Bold, decisive, and skilled in battle.

7.name: Hu Tao
7.title: Fragrance in Thaw
7.description: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

7.name: Tartaglia
7.title: Childe
7.description: No. 11 of The Harbingers, also known as "Childe." His name is highly feared on the battlefield.

7.name: Shikanoin Heizou
7.title: Analytical Harmony
7.description: A young prodigy detective from the Tenryou Commission. His senses are sharp and his thoughts are clear.

7.name: Klee
7.title: Fleeing Sunlight
7.description: An explosives expert and a regular at the Knights of Favonius's confinement room. Also known as Fleeing Sunlight.

7.name: Kuki Shinobu
7.title: Mender of Tribulations
7.description: The capable and reliable Arataki Gang deputy leader. Please note: capable and reliable are not appellations for the "Arataki Gang," but for their deputy leader in specific.

7.name: Yanfei
7.title: Wise Innocence
7.description: A well-known legal adviser active in Liyue Harbor. A brilliant young lady in whose veins runs the blood of an illuminated beast.

8.name: Mualani
8.title: Splish-Splash Wavechaser
8.description: A well-known guide in Natlan who owns a watersports shop, and expert in all forms of wave-chasing.

8.name: Iansan
8.title: Tempered in Molten Stone
8.description: Head coach of the fitness club at the Collective of Plenty, and a renowned Natlanese nutritionist.

8.name: Amber
8.title: Gliding Champion
8.description: Always energetic and full of life, Amber's the best — albeit only — Outrider of the Knights of Favonius.

8.name: Mika
8.title: Coordinates of Clear Frost
8.description: A young knight born to an ordinary family. He serves as a Front-Line Surveyor in his Company. He is a low-key and cautious character.

8.name: Navia
8.title: Helm of the Radiant Rose
8.description: The current President of Spina di Rosula, who is lovely, dutiful, and a great boss.

8.name: Chiori
8.title: The Thundering Seamstress
8.description: The owner of Chioriya Boutique. A tailor renowned throughout Fontaine.

8.name: Faruzan
8.title: Enigmatic Machinist
8.description: A researcher from "one hundred years ago." She enjoys self-identifying as everyone's senior, and has significant knowledge of ancient scripts and machines of all kinds.

8.name: Arlecchino
8.title: Dire Balemoon
8.description: "The Knave," Fourth of the Fatui Harbingers. A poised, ruthless diplomat. To the children in the House of the Hearth, she is their feared yet dependable "Father."

8.name: Ningguang
8.title: Eclipsing Star
8.description: The Tianquan of the Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.

8.name: Mavuika
8.title: Night-Igniting Flame
8.description: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.

8.name: Mona
8.title: Astral Reflection
8.description: A mysterious young astrologer who proclaims herself to be "Astrologist Mona Megistus," and who possesses abilities to match the title. Erudite, but prideful.

9.name: Chongyun
9.title: Frozen Ardor
9.description: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.

9.name: Razor
9.title: Wolf Boy
9.description: A boy who lives among the wolves in Wolvendom of Mondstadt, away from human civilization. As agile as lightning.

9.name: Albedo
9.title: Kreideprinz
9.description: A genius known as the Kreideprinz, he is the Chief Alchemist and Captain of the Investigation Team of the Knights of Favonius.

9.name: Clorinde
9.title: Candlebearer, Shadowhunter
9.description: An undefeated Champion Duelist. Sword in hand, she defends justice in the Court of Fontaine.

9.name: Aino
9.title: Clinky-Clank Gadgets-A-Gogo
9.description: A genius mechanic and inventor from Nod-Krai who loves interesting machines and sweet treats.

9.name: Emilie
9.title: A Thousand Scents Traced
9.description: A Fontainian perfumer, one who bottles secrets.

9.name: Freminet
9.title: Yearning for Unseen Depths
9.description: A reserved young man who is well-versed in diving. Beneath his distant, icy demeanor lies a pure heart bereft of all flaws.

9.name: Kamisato Ayaka
9.title: Frostflake Heron
9.description: Daughter of the Yashiro Commission's Kamisato Clan. Dignified and elegant, as well as wise and strong.

10.name: Xingqiu
10.title: Juvenile Galant
10.description: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

10.name: Furina
10.title: Endless Solo of Solitude
10.description: The absolute focus of the stage of judgment, until the final applause sounds.

10.name: Ororon
10.title: Shadow of the Night-Wind
10.description: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind who instead lives in the wild alongside all manner of life.

10.name: Xinyan
10.title: Blazing Riff
10.description: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.

10.name: Sayu
10.title: Mujina Ninja
10.description: A pint-sized ninja attached to the Shuumatsuban, who always seems sleep-deprived.

10.name: Eula
10.title: Dance of the Shimmering Wave
10.description: The Spindrift Knight, a scion of the old aristocracy, and the Captain of the Knights of Favonius Reconnaissance Company. The reason for which a descendant of the ancient nobles might join the Knights remains a great mystery in Mondstadt to this very day.

10.name: Nahida
10.title: Physic of Purity
10.description: A caged bird secluded within the confines of the Sanctuary of Surasthana who can only see the world in her dreams.

10.name: Kaedehara Kazuha
10.title: Scarlet Leaves Pursue Wild Waves
10.description: A wandering samurai from Inazuma who is currently with Liyue's Crux Fleet. A gentle and carefree soul whose heart hides a great many burdens from the past.

10.name: Flins
10.title: Shadowy Lights, Stranger Wights
10.description: A Lightkeeper of Nod-Krai, guardian of a lighthouse and graveyard on a northern isle. An enigmatic gentleman, cultured and courtly.

11.name: Xiangling
11.title: Exquisite Delicacy
11.description: A renowned chef from Liyue. She's extremely passionate about cooking and excels at making her signature hot and spicy dishes.

11.name: Skirk
11.title: Void Star
11.description: A visitor who once appeared in an Abyssal rift and the Primordial Sea, this solitary warrior mentored Tartaglia in the martial arts.

11.name: Kinich
11.title: Turnfire Hunt
11.description: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.

11.name: Varesa
11.title: Strength in Serenity
11.description: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!

11.name: Keqing
11.title: Driving Thunder
11.description: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Keqing has much to say about Rex Lapis's unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue — but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

11.name: Prune
11.title: Childlike Dreams Cherished
11.description: A diminutive Witch Hunter who has journeyed all the way from Nod-Krai with the singular purpose of rooting out a witch who, to hear her tell it, has committed every sin imaginable — including bullying little kids!

11.name: Wriothesley
11.title: Emissary of Solitary Iniquity
11.description: Duke of the Fortress of Meropide, Lord Incognito of the murky depths.

11.name: Sucrose
11.title: Harmless Sweetie
11.description: An alchemist filled with curiosity about all things. She researches bio-alchemy.

11.name: Kaeya
11.title: Frostwind Swordsman
11.description: An accomplished swordsman and a strategic thinker in the Knights of Favonius, rumored to hail from beyond Mondstadt.

12.name: Ganyu
12.title: Plenilune Gaze
12.description: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.

12.name: Nilou
12.title: Dance of Lotuslight
12.description: The star of the Zubayr Theater. She is full of warmth and innocence, and her dances are lively and elegant.

12.name: Chasca
12.title: Skyborne Arbiter
12.description: The Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, the ender of all disputes.

12.name: Neuvillette
12.title: Ordainer of Inexorable Judgment
12.description: The Chief Justice of Fontaine, known as the Iudex, is renowned for his unassailable impartiality.

12.name: Layla
12.title: Fantastical Evening Star
12.description: A Rtawahist student who specializes in Theoretical Astrology. Heavily prone to somnambulism and locked in a grinding war with sleep deprivation, the problem of restful slumber is a most troubling one to her.

12.name: Dori
12.title: Treasure of Dream Garden
12.description: An elusive merchant who has a fondness for glittering Mora.

12.name: Gaming
12.title: Leonine Vanguard
12.description: Guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency, and the head of the "Mighty Mythical Beasts" Wushou troupe.

12.name: Illuga
12.title: Nightmare's Burning Heart
12.description: Member of the investigation squad, the Nightmare Orioles. The youngest squad leader among the Lightkeepers.

12.name: Tighnari
12.title: Verdant Strider
12.description: A young researcher well-versed in botany who currently serves as a Forest Watcher in Avidya Forest. He is a straight shooter with a warm heart — and a dab hand at guiding even the dullest of pupils.

12.name: Zhongli
12.title: Vago Mundo
12.description: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.
